msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a elegant Spanish woman in her fifties). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia fondo-de-armario-19.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): An elegant Spanish woman in her fifties wearing a rust knit poncho with long fringes over a dark top with brown trousers from the reference, walking at a whitewashed street in the old town of Estepona, Málaga, Spain, with colourful flower pots, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia fondo-de-armario-19.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a rust orange knit poncho with long fringes, with dark brown trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia fondo-de-armario-36.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing an olive green maxi dress with a big purple floral print from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia fondo-de-armario-29.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a chocolate brown faux fur hooded jacket, with dark trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia fondo-de-armario-06.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a burgundy floral print long dress with long sleeves from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.

IMAGEN 4 «l2» (formato 3:4, referencia fondo-de-armario-15.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Lifestyle fashion photo: a model wearing a blue floral jacquard midi skirt with a brown leather belt from the reference, candid and relaxed in a sunny street of Estepona, Spain, natural light, framed from the knees up, editorial, shallow depth of field. IMAGEN 5 «b» (formato 16:9, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA C): Wide interior photo: the inside of a bohemian women's boutique with rails full of printed dresses, ponchos and faux fur jackets, palm plants, a pink mirror frame and a light stone floor, no people, no text, inspired by the reference, photographed like a design magazine, beautiful natural light, inviting and tidy. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage.
